svg.title: Measured cost and error with an analytic baseline
svg.desc: Local warm-query CPU medians from seven batches of ten calls, including per-query projection or matrix assembly. Setup and analytic-label generation are recorded separately. The known analytic solution is itself inexpensive, so this benchmark is an accounting exercise rather than an argument for machine learning. No paper timing is reproduced.
